subject: Post-call recap: BrightStore usage, upgrade readiness, and decision timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightstore.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & suggested next steps (BrightStore usage + upgrade readiness)

Hi Samantha — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we covered and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

High-level recap
- Pain points you flagged: intermittent latency spikes during nightly index jobs, rising per-token cost on peak workloads, and PII handling concerns for a subset of customer data.
- Goals: reduce inference unit cost ~30% for batch/ingest workloads, maintain sub-150ms cold-start p95 on interactive queries, and validate a private/VPC deployment option for regulated data by end of Q3.
- New workloads discussed: expanded nightly indexing (30% more tokens), a new reranking endpoint for search (low-latency, high-QPS), and a pilot for private deployment of PII-bound requests.

Immediate asks / next steps (proposal)
1) I attached the usage_export for May so you can see the token distribution and peak windows (usage_report_May2026.csv). We'll run a quick aggregation and model-fit for cost modeling.
2) I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_BrightStore_v1.pdf) that maps milestones (tech deep dive, pilot, procurement, deployment). Please treat as a starting point.
3) Technical deep-dive: your infra team + our runtime engs to review latency profile and deployment options. Suggested slots: Tue May 25 (10:00–11:00 PDT) or Wed May 26 (14:00–15:00 PDT). Let me know which works.
4) Pricing path: we can propose (a) Dedicated reserved capacity with committed monthly QPS, or (b) Private (VPC) deployment with enterprise licensing. I'll include a preliminary cost/benefit in the follow-up.
5) Compliance & evidence: Monica will share our SOC2 evidence and architecture notes for PII handling.

Proposed timeline (high level)
- Week of May 24: technical deep-dive + finalize pilot scope
- Week of Jun 7: pilot kickoff (2–4 weeks)
- Mid-July: procurement & SOW finalization if pilot meets objectives

Please confirm: (1) who should be on the technical deep-dive (names/emails), (2) which time above you'd prefer, and (3) any constraints from procurement (PO process/timeline).

Thanks — I'll prepare the cost model and draft SOW and share by Wed May 20.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: usage_report_May2026.csv, MAP_BrightStore_v1.pdf
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightstore.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Brown <tom.brown@brightstore.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & suggested next steps (BrightStore usage + upgrade readiness)

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Spot on about the latency spikes — they show up during concurrent nightly jobs and a small percentage of customer requests that hit longer chains. We need a solution that doesn't degrade interactivity for search.
- Procurement note: Tom Brown (cc'd) is our procurement lead and will want committed pricing options and an initial SOW. Our internal target is vendor selection by end of July; procurement cycle can take 3–4 weeks once we have the SOW and pricing.
- Compliance: we will need SOC2 evidence and a summary of network isolation options and KMS/HSM support.

Technical deep-dive: May 25 at 10:00 PDT works for our infra and search engineers. Attendees: myself, Tom Brown, Rajesh Patel (search infra), and Lina Gomez (security). Please include your runtime/infra engineer and someone who can speak to dedicated/private deployment tradeoffs.

Also, can you include a simple committed-QPS band (e.g., 50k/100k/200k monthly committed requests) and ballpark pricing for Dedicated vs Private in your follow-up? That will help procurement prioritize.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot path.

Best,
Samantha
Director of Search & Personalization, BrightStore
samantha.lee@brightstore.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call recap & suggested next steps (internal)

Looping in quick internal action items after Samantha's reply: 

- I'll package SOC2 summary + architecture notes and a one-pager on KMS/HSM and VPC networking by EOD Thu (May 21).
- Karthik: I'll need the exact May usage CSV columns you attached so I can run a cost-by-model calc. I can deliver a committed-QPS band analysis (50k / 100k / 200k) and an estimated cost delta for Dedicated vs Private by Fri May 22.
- Vivek: can you assign a runtime engineer for the deep-dive? Preferably someone familiar with batching/kv-cache tuning and quantization profiles.
- I'll also draft a short SOW skeleton (SOW_BrightStore_v1.docx) that maps pilot success criteria so procurement has something to start with.

Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightstore.com>, Tom Brown <tom.brown@brightstore.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & suggested next steps — MAP, SOW draft, and confirmed deep-dive

Thanks Samantha — confirmed for Tue May 25 10:00–10:45 PDT. Attendees: Samantha, Tom, Rajesh, Lina; from our side Monica (CS), Vivek (runtime), and I will join.

Deliverables attached and links below:
- MAP_BrightStore_v1.pdf (milestones & acceptance criteria)
- usage_report_May2026.csv (raw export)
- SOW_BrightStore_v1.docx (pilot scope + acceptance)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HS-8921
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=abc123-brightstore

Immediate next steps for this thread
- Monica: SOC2 summary + KMS notes (EOD May 21)
- Internal: cost model + committed-QPS bands (Monica & Karthik, deliver Fri May 22)
- Schedule tech deep-dive calendar invite (Karthik) — I'll send the invite with Zoom and an agenda.
- I'll prepare two pricing options (Dedicated reserved pool vs Private/VPC license) and include rough monthly figures so procurement can evaluate.

If anything missing, flag now — otherwise I'll send final calendar invite and the cost sheet later today.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: MAP_BrightStore_v1.pdf, SOW_BrightStore_v1.docx, usage_report_May2026.csv
